Commitments

As of August 27, 2026, we had commitments of approximately $9.1 billion for the acquisition of property, plant, and equipment, substantially all of which are expected to be paid within one year.

Contract Liabilities

As of August 27, 2026, customer prepayments under long-term supply agreements totaled $12.75 billion, which are refundable under certain conditions and are recognized as revenue as products are delivered.
